failures.symptom: Approved runnable work waits for another proceed/continue prompt.
failures.correction: Persistent service loop dispatches eligible work without chat dependency.

failures.symptom: Unchanged failures are retried repeatedly without changing approach.
failures.correction: Retries are bounded and transition to slow blocked recheck.

failures.symptom: Independent maintenance stages wait behind unrelated stages.
failures.correction: Periodic components dispatch independently with separate leases.

failures.symptom: One failed or blocked task prevents unrelated work from progressing.
failures.correction: Failures are assignment/component local; unrelated capacity remains dispatchable.

failures.symptom: Worker, CI, merge, or deployment success is mistaken for completed functionality.
failures.correction: PM V2 independently requires full release and operational evidence before 100 percent.

failures.symptom: Automated tests pass while the intended operational path remains unverified.
failures.correction: Functional smoke and exact live production evidence are mandatory completion checks.

failures.symptom: Restart or host loss loses work state or requires manual reconstruction.
failures.correction: Durable SQLite state plus integrity-verified snapshot and restore.

failures.symptom: Retries or parallel controllers can duplicate a work claim.
failures.correction: Atomic leases, idempotency records, and explicit V1/V2 ownership.

failures.symptom: V1 and V2 can select the same approved development issue.
failures.correction: Exact PM V2 issue selector and legacy global-scan exclusion marker.

failures.symptom: Normal production approval requires a command outside Teams.
failures.correction: PM V2 completion requires authenticated exact-SHA Teams approval evidence.

failures.symptom: Lifecycle messages omit the agreed communication standard.
failures.correction: PM V2 production lifecycle cards contain all five required status fields.

failures.symptom: An in-flight assignment can silently change scope.
failures.correction: Scope hash changes block the assignment for explicit reconciliation.

failures.symptom: Similar workflows rebuild separate approval, notification, or worker behavior.
failures.correction: PM V2 extends existing Teams, Release Manager, and owner-approved worker interfaces.
